name: Forge Signal fit rubric (default)
description: Customer methodology: tiers Direct, Very strong, Strong, Conditional, Excluded. The model extracts factor values with quotes; this rubric turns them into a tier.

centrality.description: Is the investigator's established science in the opportunity's scope?

repositioning.description: What must change for the investigator to compete?

values.partner: A partner, topic or application bridge

pi_can_lead.description: Can the investigator lead or be central?

career_stage_excluded.description: Does the sponsor restrict to a career stage the investigator is not in?

positioning_violation.description: Does it break a profile positioning rule (e.g., cancer with no mechanism bridge)?

tiers.name: Excluded
tiers.treatment: Not shown; kept in the run log.

tiers.name: Conditional
tiers.treatment: Secondary or watch unless the condition is already met.

tiers.name: Strong
tiers.treatment: Keep active with the stated condition.

tiers.name: Very strong
tiers.treatment: Pursue after a targeted fit check.

rules.reason: Sponsor restricts to a career stage the investigator is not in: excluded.
Established science is not in the program scope: excluded.
Science would have to be stretched to fit: excluded (keyword overlap only).
Scientifically adjacent: Conditional, only with a clear topic or partner bridge.
Central science, no repositioning, investigator can lead: Direct.
Central science, no repositioning, investigator cannot lead: Very strong.
Central science; needs sponsor-specific framing: Very strong.
Central science; a collaborator or bridge helps and the investigator can lead: Very strong.
Central science but depends on a partner or team the investigator cannot lead: Strong.
Partial overlap that depends on a topic, partner or bridge: Strong.
Profile positioning rule not met: capped at Conditional.
